ticket.title: Bulk action to mark selected invoices as paid
ticket.description: Accountants currently mark invoices as paid one by one after each bank import, which is slow. The invoice list should let users select several invoices with checkboxes and mark them all as paid at once, with a confirmation dialog, a default paid date of today, and already paid invoices left unchanged.

feature.userNeed: Accountants need to mark invoices as paid in bulk after each bank import, because marking them one by one takes too long.
feature.proposedBehavior: In the invoice list, each invoice has a checkbox so several can be selected. When at least one invoice is selected, a Mark as paid button appears. Clicking it opens a confirmation dialog that shows how many invoices will be changed. The paid date defaults to today. Invoices that are already paid are skipped and not changed.
acceptanceCriteria: The invoice list shows a checkbox for each invoice that lets the user select it.
The user can select several invoices at once.
The Mark as paid button appears when at least one invoice is selected.
Clicking Mark as paid opens a confirmation dialog that shows the number of invoices that will be changed.
The paid date is set to today by default.
Invoices that are already paid are skipped and are not changed.

missingInformation.question: Can the user change the paid date in the confirmation dialog, or is it always today?
